text: DSH Chinese Minimal Custom Mode 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的自定义模式设置插件。它在设置页提供助手管理界面，并通过私有路由读取和保存助手状态。用户可以编辑 Markdown 系统提示词、切换基础模式与插件行开关，创建、复制、排序和删除多个助手，也可查看提示词历史并恢复旧版本。新安装默认使用 Minimal 基础模式和中文提示词，后续仍可在页面修改。适合希望为不同任务维护独立助手和提示词的 DSH 网页用户；无需 API 密钥或外部服务，配置保存在本机 DSH 助手目录。

DSH Chinese Minimal Custom Mode adds an assistant settings page to DSH web. Edit Markdown prompts, switch modes and plugin rows, create assistants, and browse prompt history. New installs start with Minimal mode and a Chinese prompt. Data stays local; no API key or external service is needed.
我想给不同任务分别保存 DSH 助手和系统提示词。
能不能在 DSH 设置里直接编辑 Markdown 提示词和模式开关？
I want to manage several DSH assistants with separate editable system prompts.
DSH Chinese Minimal Custom Mode 的功能「提示词与基础模式编辑」：在网页设置页选择助手，编辑 Markdown 系统提示词，并调整基础模式及插件行开关；保存后更新对应助手配置。
DSH Chinese Minimal Custom Mode 的功能「多助手管理」：用户可创建新助手或复制已有助手，页面也支持重新排序和删除；新助手使用独立目录保存提示词与配置。

dsh-chinese-minimal-mode README · DSH Chinese Minimal Custom Mode：English | [中文](README.zh.md) Retains the complete `dsh-custom-mode` Settings UI for editing the system prompt, switching the base mode, toggling plugin rows, and managing multiple assistants. This fork changes only the first-install defaults: Minimal base mode and the complete system prompt `你是一个中文助手`.
dsh-chinese-minimal-mode README · DSH Chinese Minimal Custom Mode：

dsh-chinese-minimal-mode README · Install：Install the stable GemChance GitHub release:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://codeload.github.com/GemChance/dsh-chinese-minimal-mode/tar.gz/refs/tags/v2.3.0
```

Restart the process that serves the profile. The version on the settings page is the one that is running.

Desktop app: install from the in-app Plugins page. The CLI cannot modify `profiles/desktop`.

dsh-chinese-minimal-mode README · Install：On Windows, `install.sh` is bash and it needs a `dsh` executable on `PATH`. Otherwise use the `dsh` shipped with DeepSeek Harness, or `node node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js`.

dsh-chinese-minimal-mode README · Use：1. Open Settings → Custom mode.
2. Edit the system prompt. Save is directly under the editor.
3. A new session uses this assistant when `settings.yaml` has no `agent-presets.default` yet. An existing value is left as it is.

On first install, the plugin creates Custom mode with the Minimal base and initializes `prompt.md` to `你是一个中文助手`. Everything remains editable from Settings, and upgrades do not overwrite existing user data.

dsh-chinese-minimal-mode README · Use：The prompt is `prompt.md`. The next time a model step is assembled, that file is read again. History can load an older draft into the editor; loading does not write. A save computed against an older copy is refused when the file changed underneath. The model can change the same file only through `custom_prompt`, which asks first.

dsh-chinese-minimal-mode README · Use：The page is two branches. This assistant edits the one you have open, and all five base modes can be chosen. New assistant writes only when you click New assistant: Coding, Writing, and Chat stay selectable, and only the official Standard mode is lit. The other four official modes are dim and cannot be chosen there.

dsh-chinese-minimal-mode README · Use：| Posture | After create |
| --- | --- |
| Develop | Official Standard mode, tools as shipped. |
| Write | Official Standard mode. Terminal off, file tools on. |
| Chat | Official Standard mode. Files and terminal off. |

dsh-chinese-minimal-mode README · Boundaries：- It does not replace Standard, PTC, Minimal, or Creator.
- It does not ship a role-play preset.
- It does not run in the desktop profile from the CLI. Headless mode will not start a session that uses an agent preset.

dsh-chinese-minimal-mode README · Compatibility：The unit suite also passed under WSL2 Ubuntu 26.04 (Node only, no dsh process, no browser). That is not a Linux desktop result.
